content: Hi, I’m Justin McClung, a grad student at Kennesaw State working under Dr. Michael Griffin. I’d like to submit a PR proving that S and T generate SL(2, ℤ) (Subgroup.closure {S, T} = ⊤), which is currently missing from Mathlib.NumberTheory.Modular. Could I get push access? My GitHub username is JustinMcClung.
Welcome Justin! We no longer give out push access to contributors. Please see our contribution guidelines for instructions: https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/index.html
By the way, if there's an outdated doc or something that you read that suggested asking for push access, let us know so we can fix it!
